creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-16 with restarting an agent in its pane (a_2dmIEdCn6). muster pane restart --env NAME=value reaches the resumed agent, but the pane's saved resume records flags, not environment, so a later daemon restart brings the agent back without it. The HTTPS_PROXY case that motivated --env would then need the restart again. Documented in docs/cli/limits.md. Keeping a restart's variables on the pane's resume, with values never logged, is the fix if it bites.
title: A restart's --env is lost at the next daemon restart
